+/**
+ * Environment detection for template selection.
+ *
+ * Detects the presence of language-specific configuration files
+ * to determine which template should be used.
+ */
+
+import { pathExists } from "../shared/fs.js";
+import type { EnvironmentKind, TemplateMetadata } from "./types.js";
+
+export const SUPPORTED_ENVIRONMENTS: readonly EnvironmentKind[] = [
+  "rust",
+  "go",
+  "typescript",
+  "python",
+  "java",
+  "elixir",
+  "julia",
+  "crystal",
+  "base",
+] as const;
+
+const TEMPLATE_METADATA: ReadonlyArray<TemplateMetadata> = [
+  { name: "base", description: "Generic fallback template for unknown environments." },
+  { name: "rust", description: "Rust workspaces using Cargo." },
+  { name: "go", description: "Go workspaces using go.mod." },
+  { name: "typescript", description: "TypeScript/Node.js workspaces using package.json." },
+  { name: "python", description: "Python workspaces using pyproject.toml or requirements.txt." },
+  { name: "java", description: "Java workspaces using Maven or Gradle." },
+  { name: "elixir", description: "Elixir workspaces using mix.exs." },
+  { name: "julia", description: "Julia workspaces using Project.toml." },
+  { name: "crystal", description: "Crystal workspaces using shard.yml or shard.lock." },
+];
+
+export function isEnvironmentSupported(value: string): value is EnvironmentKind {
+  return SUPPORTED_ENVIRONMENTS.includes(value as EnvironmentKind);
+}
+
+export function getSupportedTemplates(): ReadonlyArray<TemplateMetadata> {
+  return TEMPLATE_METADATA;
+}
+
+export async function detectEnvironment(cwd: string): Promise<EnvironmentKind> {
+  const checks = [
+    { file: "Cargo.toml", env: "rust" as const },
+    { file: "go.mod", env: "go" as const },
+    { file: "package.json", env: "typescript" as const },
+    { file: "pyproject.toml", env: "python" as const },
+    { file: "requirements.txt", env: "python" as const },
+    { file: "pom.xml", env: "java" as const },
+    { file: "build.gradle", env: "java" as const },
+    { file: "mix.exs", env: "elixir" as const },
+    { file: "Project.toml", env: "julia" as const },
+    { file: "shard.yml", env: "crystal" as const },
+    { file: "shard.lock", env: "crystal" as const },
+  ];
+
+  for (const check of checks) {
+    const filePath = `${cwd}/${check.file}`;
+    if (await pathExists(filePath)) {
+      return check.env;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return "base";
+}

+# Makefile for cx workspaces.
+#
+# This Makefile provides a normalized interface for building, validating,
+# and packaging projects across language ecosystems.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   make          # build the native project (if any)
+#   make build    # compile using the native toolchain or no-op
+#   make bundle   # build and package the cx bundle
+#   make validate # validate the cx configuration
+#   make inspect  # show the computed bundle plan
+#   make clean    # remove generated output
+#   make notes    # show the notes directory path
+#
+CX ?= cx
+CX_CONFIG ?= cx.toml
+CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
+
+.PHONY: all build bundle validate inspect clean notes help
+all: build
+
+build: ## Build the native project if present; otherwise no-op.
+	@echo "No recognized native toolchain found; skipping compile."
+
+bundle: build ## Build native artifacts, then package a cx bundle.
+	$(CX) bundle --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+inspect: ## Show the computed bundle plan.
+	$(CX) inspect --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+validate: ## Validate the cx configuration.
+	$(CX) validate --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+clean: ## Remove generated output files.
+	rm -rf "$(CLEAN_DIR)"
+
+notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
+	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
+
+help: ## Show available targets.
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build bundle validate inspect clean notes\n"

+# Repository Notes Guide
+
+This directory is a permanent knowledge layer for the codebase. It captures architectural intent, durable concepts, constraints, and decisions that should outlive any single sprint, ticket, or contributor.
+
+## Why This Directory Exists
+
+This directory exists to keep durable repository knowledge queryable. It is not a project-management folder.
+
+- Project trackers are hierarchical and temporary.
+- Repository notes are durable and linkable.
+- The goal is preserving reusable understanding.
+
+## Before and After for Agents
+
+Before manifest-side summaries:
+
+- an agent sees `notes/` and must open raw Markdown files one by one
+- token spend rises before the agent knows which note matters
+- latency rises because every run repeats the same broad scan
+
+After manifest-side summaries:
+
+- the agent reads `manifest.notes[]` first
+- it filters by stable id, title, alias, or summary text
+- it opens only the note files that are actually relevant
+- token spend and latency drop because the broad scan is already serialized
+
+## Core Rules
+
+### Atomicity
+
+Each note must contain one discrete thought:
+- one architectural decision
+- one invariant
+- one mechanism
+- one concept
+- one failure mode
+
+If a note contains multiple unrelated ideas, split it.
+
+### Write in Your Own Words
+
+Do not paste raw code or external text. A note is only useful when it explains the idea in your own words and makes its relationship to this repository explicit.
+
+### Connect Notes Radially
+
+Every note should link outward to:
+- related notes
+- code components
+- adjacent constraints or decisions
+
+The value comes from the graph, not isolated pages.
+
+### Keep IDs Stable
+
+Each note uses a time-based YAML id in the form `YYYYMMDDHHMMSS`.
+The filename is the canonical title; the numeric id is machine authoritative.
+
+## Recommended Workflow
+
+1. Start from `template-new-zettel.md`
+2. Assign a fresh `id` using local time
+3. Give the note a clear searchable title
+4. Write one thought in your own words
+5. Add explicit links to related notes and code paths
+6. Save the file with a human-readable filename
+
+## Minimum Anatomy
+
+Every note must contain:
+
+- YAML frontmatter with `id`, `aliases`, and `tags`
+- one atomic body
+- one links section with explicit connections
+
+## What Does Not Belong Here
+
+Do not use this directory for:
+- sprint planning
+- transient checklists
+- copied code dumps
+- meeting notes without synthesis
+- backlog management

+# Makefile for Crystal workspaces.
+#
+# Provides a normalized interface for Crystal build commands and cx packaging.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   make          # build the Crystal project
+#   make build    # crystal build src/main.cr --release
+#   make test     # crystal spec
+#   make bundle   # build and package the cx bundle
+#   make validate # validate the cx configuration
+#   make inspect  # show the computed bundle plan
+#   make clean    # remove generated output
+#
+CRYSTAL ?= crystal
+CX ?= cx
+CX_CONFIG ?= cx.toml
+CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
+
+.PHONY: all build test bundle validate inspect clean notes help
+all: build
+
+build: ## Build the Crystal project in release mode.
+	$(CRYSTAL) build src/main.cr --release
+
+test: ## Run Crystal specs.
+	$(CRYSTAL) spec
+
+bundle: build ## Build native artifacts, then package a cx bundle.
+	$(CX) bundle --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+inspect: ## Show the computed bundle plan.
+	$(CX) inspect --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+validate: ## Validate the cx configuration.
+	$(CX) validate --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+clean: ## Remove generated output files.
+	rm -rf "$(CLEAN_DIR)" .crystal .shards
+
+notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
+	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
+
+help: ## Show available targets.
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build test bundle validate inspect clean notes\n"

+# Makefile for Java workspaces.
+#
+# Provides a normalized interface for Maven/Gradle builds and cx packaging.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   make          # build the Java project
+#   make build    # run Maven or Gradle build
+#   make test     # run Maven or Gradle tests
+#   make bundle   # package a cx bundle
+#   make validate # validate the cx configuration
+#   make inspect  # show the computed bundle plan
+#   make clean    # remove generated output
+#
+MAVEN ?= mvn
+GRADLE ?= gradle
+CX ?= cx
+CX_CONFIG ?= cx.toml
+CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
+
+.PHONY: all build test bundle validate inspect clean notes help
+all: build
+
+build: ## Build the Java project using Maven or Gradle.
+	@if [ -f pom.xml ]; then \
+		$(MAVEN) package; \
+	elif [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then \
+		$(GRADLE) build; \
+	else \
+		echo "No Maven or Gradle build file found."; \
+		exit 1; \
+	fi
+
+test: ## Run Java tests using Maven or Gradle.
+	@if [ -f pom.xml ]; then \
+		$(MAVEN) test; \
+	elif [ -f build.gradle ] || [ -f build.gradle.kts ]; then \
+		$(GRADLE) test; \
+	else \
+		echo "No Maven or Gradle build file found."; \
+		exit 1; \
+	fi
+
+bundle: build ## Build native artifacts, then package a cx bundle.
+	$(CX) bundle --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+inspect: ## Show the computed bundle plan.
+	$(CX) inspect --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+validate: ## Validate the cx configuration.
+	$(CX) validate --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+clean: ## Remove generated output files.
+	$(MAVEN) clean || true
+	$(GRADLE) clean || true
+	rm -rf "$(CLEAN_DIR)"
+
+notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
+	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
+
+help: ## Show available targets.
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build test bundle validate inspect clean notes\n"

+# Makefile for Python workspaces.
+#
+# Provides a normalized interface for Python venv setup, package management,
+# and cx packaging.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   make          # install dependencies and validate the environment
+#   make build    # run any project-specific build step (if defined)
+#   make test     # run unit tests
+#   make bundle   # package a cx bundle
+#   make validate # validate the cx configuration
+#   make inspect  # show the computed bundle plan
+#   make clean    # remove generated artifacts
+#
+PYTHON ?= python3
+PIP ?= pip
+CX ?= cx
+CX_CONFIG ?= cx.toml
+CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
+
+.PHONY: all build test bundle validate inspect clean notes help
+all: build
+
+build: ## Install dependencies using pip and run the build step if available.
+	$(PIP) install -r requirements.txt
+	@echo "No additional Python build step defined."
+
+test: ## Run Python tests if a test suite exists.
+	$(PYTHON) -m pytest
+
+bundle: build ## Build native artifacts, then package a cx bundle.
+	$(CX) bundle --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+inspect: ## Show the computed bundle plan.
+	$(CX) inspect --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+validate: ## Validate the cx configuration.
+	$(CX) validate --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+clean: ## Remove generated output files.
+	rm -rf "$(CLEAN_DIR)" .pytest_cache __pycache__
+
+notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
+	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
+
+help: ## Show available targets.
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build test bundle validate inspect clean notes\n"

+# Makefile for TypeScript/Node.js workspaces.
+#
+# Provides a normalized interface for package manager commands and cx bundling.
+#
+# Usage:
+#   make          # install dependencies and build
+#   make build    # run the package manager build command
+#   make test     # run the package manager test command
+#   make bundle   # build and package a cx bundle
+#   make validate # validate the cx configuration
+#   make inspect  # show the computed bundle plan
+#   make clean    # remove generated output
+#
+BUN ?= bun
+PNPM ?= pnpm
+NPM ?= npm
+YARN ?= yarn
+CX ?= cx
+CX_CONFIG ?= cx.toml
+CLEAN_DIR ?= dist
+
+.PHONY: all build test bundle validate inspect clean notes help
+all: build
+
+build: ## Build the project using the detected package manager.
+	@if command -v $(BUN) >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+		$(BUN) install && $(BUN) run build; \
+	elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then \
+		$(PNPM) install && $(PNPM) run build; \
+	elif [ -f package-lock.json ] || [ -f npm-shrinkwrap.json ]; then \
+		$(NPM) install && $(NPM) run build; \
+	elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then \
+		$(YARN) install && $(YARN) build; \
+	else \
+		$(NPM) install && $(NPM) run build; \
+	fi
+
+test: ## Run tests using the detected package manager.
+	@if command -v $(BUN) >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
+		$(BUN) test; \
+	elif [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then \
+		$(PNPM) test; \
+	elif [ -f yarn.lock ]; then \
+		$(YARN) test; \
+	else \
+		$(NPM) test; \
+	fi
+
+bundle: build ## Build native artifacts, then package a cx bundle.
+	$(CX) bundle --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+inspect: ## Show the computed bundle plan.
+	$(CX) inspect --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+validate: ## Validate the cx configuration.
+	$(CX) validate --config "$(CX_CONFIG)"
+
+clean: ## Remove generated output files.
+	if [ -f bun.lockb ]; then $(BUN) run clean; fi
+	rm -rf node_modules dist "$(CLEAN_DIR)"
+
+notes: ## Print the notes directory path.
+	@printf "Notes directory: notes\n"
+
+help: ## Show available targets.
+	@printf "Available targets:\n  build test bundle validate inspect clean notes\n"

+#:schema ./schemas/cx-config-v1.schema.json
+schema_version = 1
+project_name = "{{projectName}}"
+source_root = "."
+output_dir = "dist/{{projectName}}-mcp-bundle"
+
+[output.extensions]
+xml = ".xml.txt"
+json = ".json.txt"
+markdown = ".md"
+plain = ".txt"
+
+[repomix]
+style = "{{style}}"
+show_line_numbers = false
+include_empty_directories = false
+security_check = true
+
+[files]
+include = ["src/**", "dist/**"]
+exclude = ["node_modules/**", "tmp/**"]
+follow_symlinks = false
+unmatched = "ignore"
+
+[dedup]
+mode = "fail"
+order = "config"
+
+[manifest]
+format = "json"
+pretty = true
+include_file_sha256 = true
+include_output_sha256 = true
+include_output_spans = true
+include_source_metadata = true
+
+[checksums]
+algorithm = "sha256"
+file_name = "{project}.sha256"
+
+tokens = { encoding = "o200k_base" }
+
+[assets]
+include = ["**/*.{png,jpg,jpeg,gif,webp,svg,pdf}"]
+exclude = []
+mode = "copy"
+target_dir = "assets"
+layout = "flat"
+
+[sections.docs]
+include = ["docs/**", "notes/**", "README.md", "*.md"]
+exclude = []
+
+[sections.repo]
+include = [
+  ".gitignore",
+  ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
+  "biome.json",
+  "bin/cx",
+  "cx.toml",
+  "cx-mcp.toml",
+  "scripts/**",
+  "schemas/**",
+  "package.json",
+  "tsconfig.json",
+  "tsconfig.test.json",
+]
+exclude = []
+
+[sections.src]
+include = ["src/**"]
+exclude = []
+
+[sections.tests]
+include = ["tests/**"]
+exclude = []
